title: Jeremiah's Letter to the Exiles

questions.question: Jeremiah sent a letter to the surviving elders of the exiles, to the priests, prophets, and people whom Nebuchadnezzar had taken from Jerusalem to...?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 29:1 (ESV): "whom Nebuchadnezzar had taken into exile from Jerusalem to Babylon."

questions.question: To the exiles, the Lord says: "Build houses and live in them; plant... and eat their produce."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 29:5 (ESV): "Build houses and live in them; plant gardens and eat their produce."

questions.question: "Take wives and have sons and daughters; take wives for your sons, and give your daughters in marriage, that they may bear sons and daughters;... there, and do not decrease."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 29:6 (ESV): "multiply there, and do not decrease."

questions.question: "But seek the... of the city where I have sent you into exile, and pray to the Lord on its behalf, for in its... you will find your..."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 29:7 (ESV): "But seek the welfare of the city where I have sent you into exile, and pray to the Lord on its behalf, for in its welfare you will find your welfare."

questions.question: "Do not let your... and your diviners who are among you deceive you, and do not listen to the dreams that they dream,"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 29:8 (ESV): "Do not let your prophets and your diviners who are among you deceive you,"

questions.question: For how many years are completed for Babylon will the Lord visit the exiles and fulfill His promise to bring them back to this place?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 29:10 (ESV): "For thus says the Lord: When seventy years are completed for Babylon, I will visit you, and I will fulfill to you my promise and bring you back to this place."

questions.question: "For I know the... I have for you, declares the Lord,... for welfare and not for evil, to give you a future and a hope."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 29:11 (ESV): "For I know the plans I have for you, declares the Lord, plans for welfare and not for evil, to give you a future and a hope."

questions.question: "Then you will call upon me and come and... to me, and I will hear you."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 29:12 (ESV): "Then you will call upon me and come and pray to me, and I will hear you."

questions.question: "You will seek me and find me, when you seek me with all your..."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 29:13 (ESV): "You will seek me and find me, when you seek me with all your heart."

questions.question: "I will be found by you, declares the Lord, and I will restore your... and gather you from all the nations and all the places where I have driven you..."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 29:14 (ESV): "and I will restore your fortunes and gather you from all the nations..."

questions.question: While predicting peace for the exiles, what does the Lord say he will send upon the king and the people who remained in Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 29:17 (ESV): "Thus says the Lord of hosts, behold, I am sending on them sword, famine, and pestilence,"

questions.question: Because the people in Jerusalem refused to listen, the Lord said He would make them like what kind of figs?
options: Vile figs that are so bad they cannot be eaten
questions.correctAnswer: Vile figs that are so bad they cannot be eaten
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 29:17 (ESV): "and I will make them like vile figs that are so bad they cannot be eaten."

questions.question: What two false prophets among the exiles in Babylon does the Lord single out, saying Nebuchadnezzar will roast them in the fire?
options: Ahab the son of Kolaiah and Zedekiah the son of Maaseiah
questions.correctAnswer: Ahab the son of Kolaiah and Zedekiah the son of Maaseiah
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 29:21-22 (ESV): "Thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, concerning Ahab the son of Kolaiah and Zedekiah the son of Maaseiah, who are prophesying a lie to you in my name... Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon... shall roast them in the fire,"

questions.question: Who sent a letter from Babylon to Zephaniah the priest in Jerusalem, complaining that Jeremiah should be put in the stocks and neck-irons for saying the exile would be long?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 29:24-27 (ESV): "To Shemaiah of Nehelam you shall say... you have sent letters in your name to all the people... saying... Why then have you not rebuked Jeremiah of Anathoth who is prophesying to you?"

questions.question: What is the Lord's judgment upon Shemaiah of Nehelam for prophesying falsely and making the people trust in a lie?
options: He shall not have anyone living among this people, nor see the good the Lord will do for his people
He will be thrown into a lion's den
His house will be burned with fire
questions.correctAnswer: He shall not have anyone living among this people, nor see the good the Lord will do for his people
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 29:32 (ESV): "therefore thus says the Lord: Behold, I will punish Shemaiah of Nehelam and his descendants. He shall not have anyone living among this people, and he shall not see the good that I will do to my people, declares the Lord, for he has spoken rebellion against the Lord."

key_verse_text: "For I know the plans I have for you, declares the Lord, plans for welfare and not for evil, to give you a future and a hope."
